versions.changelog:
web-article-to-obsidian 2.0.0 introduces a unified, intelligent web article extraction and Obsidian integration platform, consolidating multiple previous tools.

- Merges wechat-article-extractor, wechat-mp-reader, and article-to-obsidian into one comprehensive skill.
- Integrates five-tiered extraction engines (browser_navigate, Playwright, Tavily, Firecrawl, HTTP) with automatic fallback for maximum adaptability.
- Supports multiple Chinese platforms (微信公众号、富途牛牛、雪球、东方财富) plus generic webpages; includes platform-specific selectors and URL normalization rules.
- Adds automated industry classification by keywords and organizes articles into structured directories in Obsidian.
- Implements advanced content cleaning, navigation/ad removal, and dual-layer (raw + structured Markdown) Obsidian storage.
- Provides detailed extraction rules, robust fault handling, and a unified Python script for end-to-end automation.
